notes: Dhiraagu's third data centre is located in N. Velidhoo, Noonu Atoll, which corresponds to South Miladhunmadulu. DCD reported the launch on 2025-11-12 and described it as a Tier III-level facility; Developing Telecoms reported on 2025-11-11 that Dhiraagu called it the first data centre located in the atolls. No MW capacity was disclosed.
